cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageShelf
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageShelf can be used to store Typetray
This is a simple shelf box.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageShelf --x 90 --sy '50*2' --sh '45*2' --outside 0 --bottom_edge e --top_edge h --retainer 10 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageShelf --x --sy --sh --outside --bottom_edge --top_edge --retainer --reference --labels
